state.context: CanFeedback must keep original authorship and private voter records, expose truthful aggregate counts, support vote/withdraw retries, preserve moderation history, prevent abusive contribution volume, link duplicate suggestions without moving votes, and route private urgent incidents to the owning support workflow. DESIGN says unconditional field locks prevent permanent removal, uniqueness includes archived rows, mutation decisions query bounded owner authority, a normalized CRUD create hook runs before commit, scenario effects do not rerun CRUD hooks, and record metadata includes created. There is no automatic private-content detector. Current source has Vote.account locked plus delete=remove and unvote deleting Vote, so that combination conflicts. Duplicate validation only checks not-self and same Product, allowing longer cycles. Desk currently has private Ticket.create by=support guarded by can_work(actor,row.location); the parallel owner is adding exported desk.open_request by=authenticated with verified actor email and active Location checks. Feedback will bind a direct form to that real operation, rather than copying public text or invoking Ticket.create as a member. Candidate A retains one Vote per suggestion/account, with active and cast_at, locks account, disables Vote CRUD and toggles active in vote/unvote. vote requires no own cast_at newer than now-10s across all retained Votes including archived, creates or reactivates the same Vote, and sets cast_at=now. unvote sets active=false without altering cast_at. Counts filter active. Suggestion.create hook allows at most five submissions per author in the preceding hour including archived, counting the staged new row; contributors cannot create Suggestion through any other path. New suggestions default hidden=true, authored content can change while pending (moderation_reason==null), owners explicitly publish or hide with a reason. Public reads require not hidden. Duplicate invariant accepts null or a different Suggestion in the same Product whose duplicate is null; dependency rechecks reject linking a target already referenced by another duplicate. It permits direct-root links, disallows chains, and keeps authors/votes attached to originals. Candidate B removes Vote.account lock while retaining permanent Vote removal, adds separate persistent submission/vote-attempt records for hourly throttling, accepts initially public suggestions with owner moderation afterward, and uses a bounded ancestry traversal to reject duplicate cycles while permitting chains. Both need source/desired-JS examples; neither implements compiler or runtime. The requested choice concerns tradeoffs, not proof. The provider operation is now authored; its exact signature, by predicate and guards follow in technical evidence.
state.canonical_support_source:
export scenario open_request(location:Location,subject:Ticket.subject,body:Message.body,category:text,priority:Ticket.priority=normal,attachments:file[]=[],client:Customer?=null label="Customer"@{nl="Klant"}) -> Ticket by=authenticated label="Open support request"@{nl="Supportverzoek openen"}
   require actor.email_verified and location.active and trim(body)!="" and trim(category)!=""
   require client==null or (client.active and location in client.locations and (owns(actor,client) or has_role(actor,client,administrator) or has_role(actor,client,booker)))
   require count(Ticket archived=include as ticket where ticket.email==actor.email and ticket.created>now-1d)<20
   do
    create Ticket {location,customer=client,subject,email=actor.email,thread=operation.id,category,priority,queue="Reception"} as ticket
    create Message {parent=ticket,external_id=format("web-{id}",{id=operation.id}),kind=customer,body,sender=actor.email,recipient=null,author=actor,attachments} as message
    return ticket

feedback_design.instructions: Which design best balances the supplied feedback requirements, audit retention, privacy, bounded abuse controls and source simplicity?

criteria.A: Retain active votes, globally space casting, cap canonical submissions, review before publication and permit only direct-root duplicate links; this avoids extra attempt models but limits link chains and uses a cooldown rather than an hourly vote-attempt counter.
criteria.B: Remove the vote lock and delete withdrawn votes, introduce durable attempt tables for hourly controls, publish first then moderate and validate duplicate ancestry; this supports chains and detailed attempt limits but adds state and permits pre-review exposure.
